$comment: Tool pins for scripts/cloud/setup.sh and the minimums scripts/cloud/preflight.ts enforces (MYK9-1397). `install` is the exact version setup.sh installs when the tool is missing; `minimum` is what preflight accepts from a provider image that already has it (gh 2.48.0 is the floor set in MYK9-1397, kept as a conservative minimum rather than a feature requirement: nothing a cloud session runs uses `gh api --slurp`, since the handoff CLI pages by hand from MYK9-1425 and the remaining --slurp callers, review-gate.ts and deferred-reviews.ts, run only on GitHub Actions runners). sha256 values were recorded from the tested Linux x86_64 release archives on 2026-10-24; deno and gh match their projects' published checksum files, shellcheck publishes none.
